name: Azure VM Pricing
description: Azure VM sizes and USD list prices for 24 regions, refreshed weekly: find the cheapest size for requirements, estimate monthly cost with reservations and savings plans, and read weekly price changes. Read-only, no credentials. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: All tools are read-only. The server downloads the public dataset from raw.githubusercontent.com and caches it for 24 hours in the OS temp folder; set AZURE_VM_PRICING_CACHE_DIR to choose another folder or AZURE_VM_PRICING_DATA_URL to point at a mirror.
